name: metabase-mcp
description: Metabase MCP server with API-key auth (no OAuth): 178 tools for queries, dashboards, admin, transforms and exports.
long_description: Connects Claude to any Metabase instance (free or paid, 0.59+) with a Metabase API key or email/password. 178 tools across 30 toolsets: questions, dashboards, collections, SQL, metrics, measures, segments, transforms, users and permissions, databases, settings, alerts, exports. Optional read-only mode and toolset/tool filtering.

metabase_url.title: Metabase URL
metabase_url.description: Base URL of your Metabase, e.g. https://metabase.example.com

metabase_api_key.title: API key
metabase_api_key.description: Metabase API key (Admin settings → Authentication → API keys). Leave empty to use email + password.

metabase_email.title: Email (optional)
metabase_email.description: Login email, only if you don't use an API key

metabase_password.title: Password (optional)
metabase_password.description: Login password, only if you don't use an API key

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Hide all tools that change Metabase content

toolsets.title: Toolsets (optional)
toolsets.description: Comma list of toolsets or presets (all, query, content, admin). Empty = all

tools_disable.title: Disabled tools (optional)
tools_disable.description: Comma list of tool names or globs to hide, e.g. delete_*
